hero.label: Youth in Work Life
hero.title:
Welcome to
the Jungle.
hero.text: The first job is an adventure, but dangers lurk there too. Learn to identify traps before you step into them.

intro.title: Why is this important?
intro.text1: Young people are the most vulnerable group in work life. Inexperience is not a weakness, but it is a risk.
intro.text2: When you don't know your rights, they are easy to trample. Uncertainty is easy to exploit.

exploitation.title: Exploitation
exploitation.text: Unpaid 'internship', overtime without pay, vague promises.

structural.title: Structures
structural.text: Chained fixed-term contracts, zero-hour contracts, lack of orientation.

intro.quote: "No, it is not part of 'company customs' for the intern to pick up the boss's kids from daycare."

career.title: Choose Your Path
career.subtitle: Different fields have different risk profiles. Explore scenarios.

it_content.title: IT & Creative
it_content.risk: Burnout, boundless working hours, 'paying with passion'.

tech_content.title: Technology & Industry
tech_content.good: Clear hours, collective agreement security, concrete work.
tech_content.risk: Physical safety, macho culture, 'boys will be boys' attitude.
tech_content.expl: Neglecting safety instructions in a rush.
tech_content.strat: Demand orientation. Do not compromise on safety.

care_content.title: Care & Service
care_content.risk: Mental load, threat of violence, ethical stress.
care_content.strat: Know your rights. Join a union.

interview.title: Interview Situation
interview.w1: If the answer is vague mumbling, it is a warning sign.
interview.q2: How does the team recover from load?
interview.w2_good: Good answer: We have regular check-in meetings.
interview.w2_bad: Bad answer: 'We work hard here, you have to withstand pressure'.
interview.flags_title: Red Flags - Run away if you hear:
interview.f2: "We are looking for a rockstar who doesn't watch the clock."
interview.f3: "The salary is small at first, but the experience is valuable."

sim.title: Summer Job Simulation
sim.desc: Test your skills in a virtual summer job. Can you hold your ground when the boss asks for a 'small favor'?

recovery.title: When Damage is Done
recovery.desc: How to recover from a bad first experience?
recovery.p1_text: One toxic place doesn't mean the whole work life is ruined. It was a lesson in what you don't want.
recovery.p2_text: Talk to a professional or a trusted adult. Do not remain alone with shame.
recovery.fact_val: I was fired during probation because 'I didn't fit the team'.
recovery.interp_val: The workplace values were in conflict with mine. I got out of a toxic environment.
recovery.note: Your story is yours. You decide its meaning.
recovery.final_quote: "No permanent mark was left on you. You are just one experience wiser."
